reading.title: How to Wash Your Hands
reading.purpose: Learn the steps for washing your hands, in order.
paras: Here is how to wash your hands the right way. First, wet your hands. Next, rub on soap. Then rub for twenty seconds.
Finally, rinse and dry. Wash before you eat and after you play outside. Clean hands help keep you well.

qs.why: Finally means at the end, so rinse and dry is the last step.

qs.q: What do you do next, after you wet your hands?
qs.why: The reading says, "Next, rub on soap."

qs.q: When should you wash your hands?
qs.why: The reading says to wash before you eat.
